name: Mount Fuji
description: Japan's highest and most revered peak, standing at 3,776 meters. An active stratovolcano and UNESCO World Heritage site iconic for its snow-capped symmetry.
highlights: Surrounded by the Fuji Five Lakes

name: Kilauea Volcano
description: One of the world's most active shield volcanoes located inside Hawaii Volcanoes National Park. Its summit crater Halemaʻumaʻu frequently hosts dynamic lava lakes.

name: Times Square
description: The bustling commercial and entertainment nexus of Midtown Manhattan, famously known as the Crossroads of the World and illuminated around the clock by massive billboards.
highlights: Duffy Square red steps gathering point
